ma.setScreenBrightness(Object object)

Set screen brightness.

Parameter

Object object

Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
value Number Yes Screen brightness. The value ranges from 0 to 1, where 0 indicates darkest and 1 indicates brightest.
success Function No Callback function for a successful API call.
fail Function No Callback function for a failed API call.
complete Function No Callback function used when an API call is complete. (This callback function is used whether the API call succeeds or fails.)

Sample Code

<view class="page-body">
  <view class="page-body-info">
    <view class="page-body-title">Current screen brightness</view>
    <text class="page-body-text-screen-brightness">{{screenBrightness}}</text>
  </view>
  <view class="page-section page-section-gap">
    <view class="page-section-title">Setting the screen brightness</view>
    <view class="body-view">
      <slider class="brightness" bindchange="changeBrightness" value="{{screenBrightness}}" min="0" max="1" step="0.1"/>
    </view>
  </view>
</view>

Page({

  data: {
    screenBrightness: 0
  },

  changeBrightness (e) {
    const value = Number.parseFloat(
      (e.detail.value).toFixed(1)
    )
    this.setData({
      screenBrightness: Number.parseFloat(
        e.detail.value.toFixed(1)
      )
    })
    ma.setScreenBrightness({
      value,
      success (res) {
        console.log(res);
      }
      ,
      fail (err) {
        console.log(err);
      },
      complete () {
        console.log('setScreenBrightness:complete');
      }
    })
  }
})
